answer: One anti-sybil mechanism: bond influence to realized outcomes. To sway a decision an identity stakes a prediction about a measurable result it produces; when the outcome lands, correct stakers gain and wrong ones are slashed. A fleet can cast a gale of votes, but here votes are bets, and being repeatedly right about real outcomes cannot be faked by cloning - it takes forecasting skill per stake. A nebula of fakes guessing randomly nets to zero and bleeds on error, so breadth buys noise, not weight. Influence concentrates on accuracy, hard as copper to counterfeit, not on identity count.
